messages:
jamal: Packaging ready to ship sealed manifest for private VPC RC5. Need final signoff + escort plan for offsite transport. Cutover window Fri 03:00-05:00 UTC. Checksums attached.

maria: Quick Q — have we rotated cosign key for this bundle? KMS policy requires ephemeral key for shipped manifests.

packaging-bot: manifest.json.sig uploaded to s3://redwood-airgap/rc5/manifest.json.sig
packaging-bot: sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...

alex: Canary matrix ready: 3 staging nodes, 2 production canaries. If canaries fail >1/3 we abort and pin to v5.3.1

jamal: Cosign key used is KMS key jw-ops/cosign-rot-2026, rotation scheduled after transport. @maria is that OK?

maria: OK. Confirmed with security: cosign key is ephemeral; post-ship rotation planned. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: [deploy-rc] canary start request submitted for rc5 at 2425000025

deploy-bot: canary status: prod-canary-1 PASS, prod-canary-2 PASS, prod-canary-3 PENDING

kate: Release notes drafted in drive: /releases/rc5-notes.md — calling out KMS rotation, pin fallback to v5.3.1, and breaking DB migration flag. Sending to CSM for customer notification.

ops-oncall: I'll be oncall for the window. Escort team: @maria @alex @jamal. If network transit issues, fallback is to hold and rerun transport next window.

maria: checksum verification snippet:
```
$ sha256sum manifest.tar.gz
e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924  manifest.tar.gz
$ cosign verify --key ksm://projects/ops/keys/cosign-rot-2026 manifest.tar.gz
VERIFIED: cosign key id: abc123
```

jamal: OK got 2/3 approvals (:thumbsup: from maria, kate). Proceeding with sealed-manifest export at 2425000060. Packaging will publish transport notice and manifest escort ETA.

packaging-bot: sealed-manifest exported to courier/manifest-rc5.tar.gz.enc

alex: Canary reports all green. No errors in boot logs. If we see > 500ms p99 delta we'll abort.

deploy-bot: canary complete — 3/3 PASS at 2425000102

jamal: Shipping now. Post-delivery actions: rotate cosign key, publish release notes, and update pinned image in registry if any rollback needed. Ops team standby.

ops-oncall: standing by. Will monitor transport and KMS audit trail. Ping here for handoff.

kate: Notifying CSM and drafting short customer advisory. ETA send T+1h after ship.

jamal: closing thread — transport in motion, manifest escort assigned. If abort needed we roll back to tag v5.3.1 and open a guidance ticket.
